Marco P.: Quick help pls. On my AMS->SFO trip I bought duty-free perfume with the corp card (receipt attached) but later returned it at the airport and the merchant issued a credit to the card in EUR. The card statement shows: charge -€75 (1652000000), credit +€75 (1652200000). The expense tool sees only the charge and flagged it as unreconciled. How should I submit so finance doesn't reimburse the refunded amount?
expense-bot: For returns/merchant credits on corporate cards, submit a split expense or attach both charge + credit receipts and include the merchant credit reference. Example:```/expenses submit
line1: 75 EUR -> business, attach purchase_receipt.pdf
line2: -75 EUR -> merchant_credit, attach refund_slip.pdf
notes: "Duty-free return - merchant credit posted to card"```
Marco P.: I have both PDFs uploaded: purchase_receipt.pdf -> https://redwood-files/receipts/df_purchase_1748456789.pdf ; refund_slip.pdf -> https://redwood-files/receipts/df_credit_1748456789.pdf
Priya (Finance): Thanks @Marco. Two things: 1) please include the card-statement USD equivalents in the notes so our ledger matches the bank posting (bank converted to USD on 2025-07-03). 2) we'll mark the net expense as $0 for reconciliation but still need the original line to show the business intent. If there was any duty/tax difference the merchant didn't refund, note that too.
Marco P.: Bank shows -$82.50 and +$82.50 so net zero. There was a €2 tax not refunded (bank converted to $2.20). Should I create a separate small personal expense for the $2.20 (or mark as finance loss)?
Priya (Finance): For amounts under $5 that are leftover due to FX/tax shortfalls, finance covers it. We'll absorb the $2.20. Submit the split with the two lines and include the USD posted amounts in parentheses. We'll process and close the reconciliation.
corp-card-bot: Transaction pair matched. Status: ready-for-review -> /expenses view 1748456789
Marco P.: Submitted with notes and tags. Thanks!
Priya (Finance): Confirmed, leaving a note on the ledger: "Duty-free return, merchant credit matched, residual tax/FX <$5 absorbed by finance". Closing the thread. :white_check_mark:
